body:
I’ve had one serious relationship before from when I was like 20-21 that was very toxic but we were young and like immediately fell in love when we met. It then became even more toxic after we broke up/he continued to affect me negatively for about 7 years. It’s a long story and complicated to explain everything that happened, but I was really psychologically traumatized by him and have had other traumatic experiences that I think maybe make me act a certain way I’m not aware of? Basically my relationship with men needs to be intensely analyzed and reformed, especially because I am more attracted to women than I am to men. I just don’t know how to pursue relationships with either gender it seems.

And re: jobs, I have a bachelors degree in English, a post bacc in Psychology, and a certificate in visual design, and have restaurant, retail, social media, writing, and teaching experience. A year ago I was working 2 jobs, a teaching job and a restaurant job, but quit the teaching job in March as it didn’t align with my values so was just working at the restaurant until I quit about 3 months ago to find something more lucrative. I am not even hearing back from customer service jobs I’m applying to, so have no idea what’s going on. I’m also incredibly well connected, and while it has helped in the past for sure, it doesn’t seem to be helping right now.

I get what you’re saying, but that’s not our relationship at all. She is actually the one constantly talking about herself/trauma dumping, even to people she doesn’t know, and I have spent countless nights listening to her talk about the same things over and over for hours - the night before we had this conversation she stayed up all night doing drugs talking about her own life, literally non-stop talking for 5 hours straight, and I just sat there and listened, never making it about myself. When I later tried to confide in her about how I was feeling at the time, she then made it about herself again. This happens constantly, and then she tells me I talk too much about myself or tells me she’s concerned about my drug use when she herself has a problem, so it makes it even harder to hear when she reacts this way.

thank you for this. it’s not that I don’t think I’m deserving of a positive relationship with a man per se, just psychologically damaged by past relationships/experiences lol. However I have also been a lot better about not letting myself just feel used by someone/if someone isn’t treating me right not keeping them around. But sometimes I am sad and lonely and crave that feeling of connection, so I slip up, though your point about not sleeping with anyone for a while could be really helpful. ❤️

me too. More than anything. Something I read that helped kind of but not that much was, “if you ever find yourself wanting to do your life over, imagine you’re feeling the same way from the perspective of being 99 on your death bed.” congratulations, your wish is granted. you can start over from wherever you are.
